macro.overnight_read: The US Dollar is dominating with the index at 122.6503 and UUP in an uptrend. Crypto is in a state of 'Extreme Fear' (11), while equity breadth is weak with only 35% of stocks above their 50-day average and an inverted VIX term structure signaling near-term stress.
macro.summary: The market is in a risk-off regime driven by a surging US Dollar and a heavy sell-off in growth and semiconductors. We are rotating into defensive sectors like staples (XLP) and utilities (XLU) while utilizing the extreme fear in crypto for speculative mean-reversion bets. With the VIX at 25.46 and poor breadth, we will avoid momentum chasing and focus on USD strength and defensive hedges ahead of the Nov 25 PCE and GDP data.
